notes: Fern and short tuft much improved.

defects.text: Fern now a full upright shuttlecock of arching fronds, no flat star.
Green short tuft is irregular and dense.
Reed basal mass hides the bare culms.
Card edges: straight vertical cut edges and a star-shaped footprint show at the base of the tufts and reed.
defects.fix: Taper each card toward its base so blades converge into a tuft base (width 0.6 at ground to 1.0 at half height).

defects.text: Dry short/tall, green tall and meadow tufts still use the v1 plain symmetrical cards.
defects.fix: Give them the same card_stand treatment as green_short.
